ingredients.name: egg yolks, beaten (or 1/3 cup egg substitute)

steps.instruction: Spray a 1-quart casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, stir 1 cup of mashed sweet potato and 1/2 cup of mashed banana.
Add 1 cup of evaporated skim milk and blend well.
Mix in 2 tablespoons of brown sugar, 2 beaten egg yolks and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Move the sweet potato mixture to the casserole dish.
Combine 1/4 cup of raisins, 1 tablespoon of sugar and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon.
Sprinkle the raisin mixture over the top of the sweet potato mixture.
Bake for 40 minutes, until a knife near the center comes out clean.
steps.spoken: Bake for 40 to forty-five minutes, until a knife stuck in near the center comes out clean.
